title: Paloma Business Low-Activity Billing of the Monthly Fee
content:
On a monthly-billed Paloma Business account, how the plan's monthly fee is billed for a billing period depends on the payouts the account submitted in the month before the day the charge is worked out, counted from the day after the same calendar day one month earlier up to and including that day, and on the whole months since KYB approval.

### The billing ladder

| Whole months since KYB approval | Payouts submitted in that month | Monthly fee as billed |
|---|---|---|
| 12 or more | None | Half the monthly fee, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| 12 or more | 1 or 2 | Three quarters of the monthly fee, rounded up to the whole dollar |
| 12 or more | 3 or more | The monthly fee in full |
| Fewer than 12 | Any number | The monthly fee in full |

Restated as a clause: an account whose KYB approval is at least 12 whole months old and that submitted no payout in that month is billed half the monthly fee, rounded down to the whole dollar; an account whose KYB approval is at least 12 whole months old and that submitted one or two payouts in that month is billed three quarters of the monthly fee, rounded up to the whole dollar; every other account is billed the monthly fee in full.

### Billed amounts on each plan

| Plan | Half, rounded down to the whole dollar | Three quarters, rounded up to the whole dollar |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Business Starter | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Paloma Business Essentials | 9.00 | 15.00 |
| Paloma Business Growth | 24.00 | 37.00 |
| Paloma Business Pro | 64.00 | 97.00 |
| Paloma Business Scale | 149.00 | 225.00 |
| Paloma Business Enterprise | 374.00 | 562.00 |

### Window and boundary (hypothetical dates)

- A charge worked out on 15 May counts the payouts submitted from 16 April through 15 May.
- An account approved on 15 May of one year has 12 whole months since approval on 15 May of the next year, and 11 on 14 May of that next year.
- On Paloma Business Growth, an account approved 30 whole months earlier with exactly 2 payouts submitted in the month is billed 49.00 multiplied by three quarters, 36.75, rounded up to 37.00 USD; with 3 payouts it is billed the 49.00 USD in full.
